Container.Name: FormCraft
Container.Overview:
FormCraft is a self-hosted form builder: a drag-and-drop builder with 12 question types (including Terms & conditions and File upload) and 13 templates, quizzes with scoring, a submissions table with filters, charts, CSV, PDF and Excel reports, users and roles, email, Telegram and WhatsApp alerts, two-factor sign-in, multilingual forms (English, Arabic, Tamil) with right-to-left support, light and dark themes, automatic backups and an Android app.
NOTIFICATIONS: link your WhatsApp by scanning a QR code in Settings, Notifications (like WhatsApp Web), add a Telegram bot and SMTP email. Send response alerts and PDF / Excel reports to your team or to outside recipients, and a confirmation to the person who filled the form. The container needs internet access for this.
DATABASE: this template uses the built-in SQLite database, stored in the Data folder below. Nothing else to install. To use PostgreSQL instead, set Database URL to postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DBNAME?schema=public (create the empty database first; the tables build themselves on first start).
BACKUPS: automatic backups run daily at 02:00 (Unraid's time zone) into the backups folder inside Data; change the schedule in Settings, Database. Copy them off the server too.
UPDATES: Settings, About shows your version and checks for a new one. To update on Unraid, use Docker tab, FormCraft, Update (or Check for Updates).
ANDROID APP: download the APK from the GitHub releases page and enter this server's address when it opens.
First run: open the WebUI and create your admin account. There is no default password.
Container.Description: Self-hosted form builder: drag-and-drop forms, 13 templates, 4 form looks, file uploads, quizzes, submissions with charts and CSV / PDF / Excel reports, roles, email / Telegram / WhatsApp alerts, two-factor sign-in, multilingual forms, dark mode, automatic backups and an Android app.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port you open FormCraft on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, uploaded logos, cover images and files people attach to responses, automatic backups (backups folder), the linked WhatsApp session and restore snapshots. Keep this folder in your backups.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Leave as is for SQLite. For PostgreSQL use postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/formcraft?schema=public

Config.Name: Demo data
Config.Description: Load demo forms with sample responses into an empty database (only on the very first start).

Config.Name: Per-form port range
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. 4001-4010: every form gets its own port that serves only that form. Also add each port to the container (or use Host networking).

Config.Name: Update check
Config.Description: Check GitHub every 6 hours for a newer FormCraft and tell admins under the bell and in Settings, About.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the Data folder (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the Data folder (100 = users on Unraid).
